newsitem.title: USA: Medizone former CEO resigns from board.
newsitem.headline: Medizone former CEO resigns from board.

text.p: Medizone International Inc said Wednesday Joseph Latino has resigned from its board, effective immediately.
Latino was terminated as president, chief executive and chairman on May 14, but he remained a member of the board in accordance with the company's bylaws.
In June, the company said it would "take action" to remove Latino from the board. It said its newly elected board requested his resignation, but Latino declined.
In a written statement released Wednesday announcing Latino's resignation, the company did not provide information on why he resigned.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
Milton Adair replaced Latino as president and CEO.
